headline: BTG views Raia Drogasil share dip as entry point despite slowing Ozempic sales growth
summary: BTG Pundits noted that while sales growth for Ozempic has stopped accelerating at Raia Drogasil, recent declines in the pharmaceutical retailer's stock price present an attractive investment opportunity.
why: Raia Drogasil is a leading Brazilian pharmacy chain whose retail performance reflects consumer health trends and discretionary spending.

impacts.name: Raia Drogasil
impacts.why: Analysts view recent share price drops as an opportunity despite slowing growth for specific products.
